channel.title: Marketing & Sales Software — new honest reviews
channel.description: Hand-researched software reviews: real pricing, the catch and who should skip it.

item.title: Lensmor Review (2026): Trade-Show Leads on Credits, From $499
item.description: Lensmor: 10,000 for $249, 25,000 for $549 or 60,000 for $1,199, valid for 12 months. The entry price is high: $499 a month for Basic.

item.title: EditEngine Review (2026): Shopify Bulk Editor, Free to $49.99
item.description: EditEngine has a free plan and three paid plans, and every plan allows unlimited bulk edit, import and export tasks. Undo covers supported in-app edits only.

item.title: Visibility Mesh Review (2026): Shopify AI Search Audits, From $29
item.description: Visibility Mesh: Three plans, billed in USD through Shopify every 30 days, each with a 7-day free trial that includes one full scan.

item.title: Froonze Review (2026): Shopify Loyalty, Free Under 100 Orders
item.description: Froonze: Free, then $10, $20 and $40 by order volume. Modular pricing is cheap per plugin but adds up.

item.title: Try You Review (2026): AI Try-On With No Monthly Fee, From $0.04
item.description: Try You: Free to install with 10 free try-ons, then pay per successful try-on with no monthly subscription. The cost scales with use, not with sales.

item.title: Brandify Review (2026): AI Visibility Service, From $479 a Month
item.description: Brandify: Google Search management is $250 a month plus $250 setup on every plan. You pay for a monthly work allowance, not for results.

item.title: RoverLead Review (2026): Signal-Led Outreach From $149 a User
item.description: RoverLead has two self-serve plans, both priced per user. RoverLead automates outreach on LinkedIn.

item.title: Riibase CRM Review (2026): Flat Team Pricing From $9.90
item.description: Riibase CRM: Starter is $9.90 a month for up to 5 users, 500 records and 5,000 AI credits. Subscription fees are non-refundable unless stated otherwise.

item.title: Rewarx Studio AI Review (2026): Product Photos on Credits
item.description: Rewarx Studio AI: Free gives 10 AI product photo credits. The listing states no refund terms, no rollover of unused credits and no price for extra credits.

item.title: TrueReview Review (2026): Request Limits, Locations and Add-ons
item.description: TrueReview: Small Business $99, or $59 yearly ($708). The yearly discount is steep but the terms make every payment non-refundable.

item.title: Doba Review (2026): Dropshipping Plans From $29.99 a Month
item.description: Doba: Billed monthly, Limited is $29.99 a month, Basic $59.99, Standard $149.99 and Enterprise $299.99. The subscription only buys access.

item.title: Redeemly Review (2026): Shopify Cashback as Store Credit
item.description: Redeemly: Free covers 0 to 50 orders. The price follows every order your store takes, not the orders that earn cashback, and the higher tiers climb to $249.

item.title: EliteCart Review (2026): Shopify Cart Drawer From $29.99/mo
item.description: EliteCart: Two published plans and one on request, with no free plan. The trial is 15 days on the listing and 14 on the pricing page.

item.title: Kedra Checkout Rules & Upsells Review (2026): From $6.99/mo
item.description: Kedra Checkout Rules & Upsells: Starter is $6.99 a month, or $58.70 a year. The free plan runs a single rule with a single condition, and Starter only three.

item.title: Assortion Review (2026): Shopify Upsells Priced by Orders
item.description: Assortion has one feature set and charges by the size of your store. The price follows your total store orders.

item.title: Tapform Review (2026): Lead Forms, Free Tier Capped at 5 Leads
item.description: Tapform — Free is $0.00 a month: 5 leads a month, 1 form, 1 workspace, 1 user, 100 MB of storage. The yearly price on the pricing page does not add up.

item.title: Brand24 Review (2026): Social Listening From $199 a Month
item.description: Brand24: Individual is $249 a month billed monthly or $199 a month billed annually. AI Insights and Topics begin on Pro at $399 billed annually.

item.title: OutSends Review (2026): Cold Email From $19 a Month
item.description: OutSends: Four fixed plans, each with unlimited campaigns, sequences and templates and no daily sending caps. The cards do not name their currency.

item.title: CarouselBot Review (2026): AI Carousels From $10 a Month
item.description: CarouselBot — Free is $0 forever: 3 carousels a month, plus 3 card sets, 1 batch collection and 1 document in total, up to 2,500 words per document.

item.title: Superlines Review (2026): AI Search Visibility From 79 € a Month
item.description: Superlines: Three self-service plans and Enterprise. Starter has no data exports and only 1 month of history.

item.title: SurFox AI Review (2026): $49 AI Lead Texting, Tested in a Sandbox
item.description: SurFox AI: Growth Plus is $1,497 a month. Billing starts at signup, but you cannot send a text until US carriers approve your A2P registration.

item.title: FeedbackGate Review (2026): A Rating Gate Google's Rules Forbid
item.description: FeedbackGate: Three monthly plans, each with a 14-day free trial. Used as designed, it can cost you the reviews it collected.

item.title: Content Raptor Review (2026): $47 per Site, GSC-Led, No Refunds
item.description: Content Raptor: Pro is $47 a month per site. The home page's endorsements, including a founder's quote comparing it with a $1,400-a-year Surfer bill.

item.title: Sender Review (2026): Free Up to 2,500 Subscribers
item.description: Sender: The Free Forever plan costs nothing, needs no card. The cheapest paid price only covers 500 subscribers, fewer than the 2,500 on the free plan.

item.title: CiteRoute Review (2026): Free GEO Scans, AI-Bot Data From $79
item.description: CiteRoute: Four plans, billed monthly. The GEO score is CiteRoute's own algorithm, and its terms say outright that it cannot guarantee citations or rankings.

item.title: PostOnce Review (2026): €12 a Month, No Trial, No Refunds
item.description: PostOnce: Solo is €15 a month, or €144 a year billed once. The only way to look before paying is a demo with sample data, not your own accounts.

item.title: Vify Order Printer Review (2026): Free Stops at 50 Orders
item.description: Vify Order Printer: Premium is $29.99 a month or $299 a year and adds more templates, custom invoices and quotes, a custom sender email, commercial invoices.

item.title: Upsell & Cross Sell - AW Review (2026): Priced by Clicks
item.description: Upsell & Cross Sell - AW: StartUp Upsell is $29.99 a month or $299 a year (the listing says save 17%). The meter is recommendation clicks.

item.title: Lusha Review (2026): 40 Free Credits, and a Phone Costs 5 of Them
item.description: Lusha: Free is $0 with 40 credits a month, 1 seat and no credit card. Annual credits are granted upfront and reset at the end of the year.

item.title: LifterLMS Review (2026): Free Core, Bundles Renew at $398 and Up
item.description: LifterLMS: Earth is $199 for the first year, normally $398. Taking payments needs a paid bundle, and every bundle renews at twice the first-year price.
